reading.rtitle: Sucafina Brazil -- Action Plan for the Next 30 Days
paras: Hello team. This is our plan for the next thirty days. Our main target is simple: we are going to close all the corrective actions from the last verification visits. The timeline is short, so we are going to work fast.

First, Carlos is going to follow up with the six producers in Minas Gerais. He is going to send one email to each producer and ask for the missing documents. This is our top priority. Without the documents, we are not going to close anything.

After that, I am going to implement the new checklist in the IMS system. I am going to train the team on April tenth. Carlos is going to deliver the final report by April thirtieth. It is going to be a busy month, but the plan is clear.

listenings.text: This is how I plan my month. First, I look at the corrective actions from the last visits. Then I write my priorities for the next thirty days. This month, I am going to follow up with six producers, and I am going to visit four farms. My target is to close every action before the deadline. I am going to deliver the final report on April thirtieth. The timeline is short, so I am not going to wait until the last week.

Hi Carlos, this is Emma. I read your plan for the next thirty days, and it is very clear. Two comments. First, the training: I am going to train the team on April tenth, not on the fifteenth, so please put the new date in the timeline. Second, the four farm visits are a high priority, so let us do them in the first two weeks. I am going to send you the new checklist tomorrow. Thank you, Carlos. Talk soon.

extra_audio.text: First, the target: we are going to close all the corrective actions. Then the first step: I am going to follow up with the six producers this week. Next, the new system: Emma is going to implement the new checklist in April. After that, the training: the team is going to learn the new checklist on April tenth. Finally, the deadline: I am going to deliver the final report by April thirtieth.
